quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to fill your bag with books before school"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: Books, pencils, and homework all go inside this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack our backpack in the morning so we're ready for school.
quests.funFact: Packing your backpack the night before can save you time in a busy morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to cover your toes before your shoes go on"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: These go on your feet, right before your shoes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on socks to keep our feet warm before our shoes go on.
quests.funFact: Matching two socks together can be a fun little puzzle every morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to enjoy a small, tasty bite between meals"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: This is smaller than a full meal, just a little bite.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat a snack in the afternoon for a little extra energy.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make a healthy and tasty afternoon snack!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Anytime to take a cool sip and feel refreshed"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: A cup or a bottle helps you do this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We drink water to keep our body cool and full of energy.
quests.funFact: Your body needs water to help you think, play, and grow every day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Midday to refuel with a tasty meal at school or home"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: This meal happens in the middle of the day, not the morning or night.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat lunch in the middle of the day to refuel.
quests.funFact: Eating a balanced lunch can help you stay focused for your afternoon classes!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to cover your feet before you head outside"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: You do this right before you walk out the door.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on our shoes before we head outside for the day.
quests.funFact: Velcro shoes were invented to help little hands get ready all by themselves!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Anytime to rinse away germs before you eat"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: Soap, water, and a good scrub are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash our hands to keep sneaky germs away.
quests.funFact: Washing your hands for about twenty seconds is the same as singing a short song!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to close your eyes for a short, restful sleep"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: This sleep is shorter than your nighttime sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! We take a nap in the afternoon to rest and recharge.
quests.funFact: Even grown-ups sometimes enjoy a short afternoon nap to feel refreshed!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to slip on your favorite pair before school"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: Laces, velcro, or buckles help keep these snug on your feet.
quests.explanation: That's right! Shoes protect our feet for walking, running, and playing.
quests.funFact: Wearing the right shoes helps keep your feet safe while you run and play!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Anytime to keep your hands clean after playing outside"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: You do this before meals and after playing outside.
quests.explanation: That's right! Washing our hands with soap keeps us healthy.
quests.funFact: Clean hands are one of the best ways to stay healthy and strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning and Night to keep your teeth white and clean"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: You do this twice a day, not just once.
quests.explanation: That's right! Brushing our teeth keeps our smile clean and strong.
quests.funFact: Baby teeth need brushing too, even though new teeth will grow in later!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to rest your body with a little quiet sleep"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: A soft blanket and a quiet room help with this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! A short nap helps us feel refreshed for the rest of the day.
quests.funFact: A short nap can help you feel happier and more focused afterward!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to nibble on something yummy before dinner"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: Fruit, crackers, or cheese are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! A snack is a small, tasty bite between meals.
quests.funFact: A small snack can help keep your tummy happy until dinner time!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to warm your feet before you get dressed further"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: They can be striped, spotted, or your favorite color.
quests.explanation: That's right! Socks keep our toes cozy all day long.
quests.funFact: Cozy socks can help keep your whole body feeling warm on a chilly day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to open your eyes and start a brand new day"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: Your eyes open, and a brand new day is waiting for you.
quests.explanation: That's right! Waking up is the very first step of our morning routine.
quests.funFact: Getting enough sleep at night helps you wake up feeling happy and ready to play!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to tidy your blankets and pillow after waking up"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: You do this right after you get out of bed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Making the bed means smoothing out sheets and fluffing pillows.
quests.funFact: A neatly made bed is extra cozy and inviting when it's time to sleep again!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Midday to take a break and enjoy a sandwich or snack"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: A sandwich, some fruit, or a lunchbox are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Lunch gives us energy for the rest of our busy day.
quests.funFact: Lunchtime is a great time to chat and laugh with your friends!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to gather your homework and supplies for the day"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: You carry this on your back all the way to school.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing our backpack means gathering books and supplies for the day.
quests.funFact: A backpack with both straps on your shoulders is comfier to carry all day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to get strong energy for learning and play"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: A bowl of cereal or a piece of toast are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Breakfast is the first meal that helps us feel strong.
quests.funFact: Eating a healthy breakfast can help you feel focused during your first class!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to enjoy a quick treat like fruit or crackers"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: You enjoy this between lunch and dinner.
quests.explanation: Well done! A healthy snack helps keep our energy up until dinner.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make a healthy and tasty afternoon snack!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Anytime to keep your body cool and full of energy"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: This helps your body feel cool and full of energy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Drinking water helps us feel refreshed all day long.
quests.funFact: Drinking water instead of sugary drinks is a great habit for a healthy body!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to snuggle up for a short bit of rest"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: This happens in the middle of the day, not at night.
quests.explanation: Well done! Napping gives our busy bodies a little extra rest.
quests.funFact: Even grown-ups sometimes enjoy a short afternoon nap to feel refreshed!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to get your feet ready for walking and running"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: Your feet need this before running, walking, or playing outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on shoes is one of the last steps before we leave home.
quests.funFact: Velcro shoes were invented to help little hands get ready all by themselves!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to change into soft, comfy clothes for sleeping"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: You put these on right after your bath.
quests.explanation: That's right! Pajamas are soft, comfy clothes just for sleeping.
quests.funFact: Soft, comfy pajamas can help your body feel relaxed and ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Anytime to scrub away germs with soap and water"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: It helps stop tiny, sneaky germs from spreading.
quests.explanation: Well done! Clean hands help stop germs before we eat or play.
quests.funFact: Washing your hands for about twenty seconds is the same as singing a short song!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to make your hair neat and tidy"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: You do this after washing your face, before you leave home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Combing our hair smooths out sleepy tangles.
quests.funFact: Some children like fun hairstyles like braids or ponytails after combing their hair!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning and Night to chase away sneaky sugar bugs"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: Bubbly white foam and a minty taste are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! We brush twice a day to keep our teeth sparkling.
quests.funFact: Dentists say we should brush for about two minutes, the same time as a short song!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to share a warm meal with your family"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: This meal happens after playtime, closer to bedtime.
quests.explanation: That's right! Dinner is the last big meal we share with family.
quests.funFact: Many families enjoy eating dinner together at the very same table each night!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Midday to fill your tummy halfway through your busy day"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: You often eat this at school, between classes.
quests.explanation: Well done! Eating lunch helps us feel ready for afternoon fun and learning.
quests.funFact: Eating a balanced lunch can help you stay focused for your afternoon classes!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to say a sweet goodbye before everyone falls asleep"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: A hug or a kiss often comes along with these words.
quests.explanation: That's right! Saying good night is a warm way to end our day.
quests.funFact: Families all around the world have their own special way of saying good night!
